outcome: Prevalence of otitis media with effusion (OME)
cohort: The study included four-year-old children in Aotearoa New Zealand whose hearing data were collected as part of the B4 School Check.
finding: The delivery of hearing screening in Aotearoa New Zealand is inequitable, disproportionately missing Maori and Pacific children and those living with higher deprivation who have higher rates of disease and poorer access to appropriate management.
cross-section timing: Hearing screening was performed at four years of age, with data analysed over a five-year period.
